title: Cosine similarity top-k search
summary: Normalize embedding rows, score queries against documents with cosine similarity, and return the top k documents with a fixed tie rule.

mutants.column_norm: Takes the norm over axis 0, so it normalizes columns and not rows.
mutants.in_place_normalize: Divides the input array in place, so the caller's vectors change.
mutants.no_zero_guard: Divides by a zero norm, so a zero vector gives NaN and not 0.
mutants.reversed_ties: Sorts ascending and reverses the order, so equal scores put the higher index first.
mutants.skip_first: Drops the best match and returns ranks 2 to k + 1, as if it removed a self match.
